selection: all records in the two pinned categories; references with no allowed required alternatives remain excluded and named
reference_call: first allowed nonempty alternative for each required parameter, omit optional parameters with the empty-string sentinel, preserve source order, Python repr inside one bracketed call; require the unchanged upstream AST checker to accept every selected target
continuation: tokenize the selected call without special tokens, append the pinned tokenizer EOS, concatenate after the unchanged prompt token IDs
context: no truncation; assert each prompt plus target fits the model context
runtime: same pinned models, adapter, tokenizer, eager attention, two torch threads and cached DoRA weight norms as the generation protocol
teacher_forcing: all profiles receive identical prompt and target-prefix IDs at every measured position, including the final EOS position
probabilities: float64 log-softmax of the actual native forward logits; finite logits and metrics required
metric: per-question mean target-token negative log likelihood in nats; token-weighted aggregate retained separately
drift: at identical prefixes, KL(reference || candidate), total variation and argmax disagreement against unmerged-f32 and unmerged-bf16; also retain the first continuation-token predictions
limits: a selected valid answer is not the full set of acceptable answers; these are conditional probability and numerical diagnostics, not BFCL accuracy, generation success, held-out quality or a full leaderboard submission
